13 / FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Curious about solar?
Let's clear it up.

Still have questions? Speak with our team about your home or commercial property.

Get a Quote ↗
How much does solar panel installation cost in Mildura?

Pricing depends on the size of the system, equipment selected, roof conditions and installation requirements. Request a tailored quote to understand the costs for your property.

What size solar system do I need?

The right size depends on your electricity usage, roof space, budget and future needs. Reviewing your bills and property is a useful starting point.

Is solar battery storage worth installing?

A battery can allow you to use more of your own solar generation outside daylight hours. Value depends on electricity tariffs, usage and the total installed cost.

Can I add a battery to an existing solar system?

Often this is possible, but compatibility, inverter type and electrical requirements must be assessed first.

Are solar incentives available in Victoria and NSW?

Government incentives may apply depending on the property, products and current program rules. Eligibility should be checked at the time of quoting.

How often should solar panels be serviced?

Follow manufacturer guidance and arrange an inspection if you notice faults, reduced output or visible damage. Electrical work should be handled by appropriately qualified professionals.

Can solar power charge an electric vehicle?

Yes, a suitably designed system and compatible charging equipment can allow some EV charging from solar generation.

Do you service Wentworth, Robinvale and Ouyen?

These are among the areas listed by Prolific Electrical. Contact the team to confirm availability for your exact location and project.
